question: In ΔABC, P and Q are points on AB and BC, respectively, such that PQ ∥ AC. Given that AB = 26, PQ = 7 and AC = 10 find the value of AP.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since PQ ∥ AC, ΔPBQ is similar to ΔABC.

We can use a direct ratio shortcut to find the lower segment AP:

⇒ AP / AB = (AC − PQ) / AC

⇒ AP / 26 = (10 − 7) / 10

⇒ AP = 26 × (3 / 10) = 26 × 0.3

⇒ AP = 7.8

**∴ The correct answer is 7.8.**
